name: Yokai: Lust Secret 🪭
source:
Yokai: Lust Secret is an adult visual novel set in a mysterious Asian folklore world. Strange events, eerie encounters, and seductive yokai blur the line between reality and illusion. Uncover the truth before you’re pulled too deep.
